## What failed?

Name the skill or helper, host (Claude Code/Codex), relevant version, and repository commit.

## Minimal reproduction

Provide a sanitized task and the smallest artifacts needed. Do not include secrets or private data. Report sensitive security issues through SECURITY.md.

## Expected and actual behavior

Distinguish observed results from assumptions. Include relevant evidence or errors.

## Scope

What users or workflows are affected? Is there a workaround?
